new='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    divider = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    if not divider:
        return out
    if len({c for r, c in divider}) == 1:
        axis = 'v'
        line = divider[0][1]
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
        if not pts: return out
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
        shift = (line + 1 - lo) if lo > line else (line - 1 - hi)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in pts:
            nc=c+shift
            if 0 <= nc < w: out[r][nc]=grid[r][c]
        edge = (hi+shift+1) if lo > line else (lo+shift-1)
        if 0 <= edge < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][edge]=8
    else:
        line = divider[0][0]
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
        if not pts: return out
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
        shift = (line + 1 - lo) if lo > line else (line - 1 - hi)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in pts:
            nr=r+shift
            if 0 <= nr < h: out[nr][c]=grid[r][c]
        edge = (hi+shift+1) if lo > line else (lo+shift-1)
        if 0 <= edge < h: out[edge]=[8]*w
    return out
'''
